summary: Master data analytics for inventory management and demand forecasting. Join our course to improve your decision-making and boost operational efficiency.
lede: Inventory management and demand forecasting use demand history and stock records to guide replenishment decisions. For inventory planners, demand planners, and supply chain analysts, the course focuses on setting stock policies and replenishment timing. Learners practise preparing and segmenting demand data, comparing forecasts and measuring error, and calculating safety stock and reorder points.
audienceIntro: This inventory analytics course suits professionals who make, review, or govern stock and demand decisions across planning, procurement, warehousing, sales, and operations. It is appropriate for foundation-to-intermediate learners who can work with basic spreadsheets and want a structured approach to inventory management and demand forecasting.
audience: Procurement Specialists using demand signals to plan
prerequisites: No prior forecasting certification or programming experience is required. You should have basic spreadsheet skills, including sorting, filtering, formulas, and simple charts, plus familiarity with inventory, sales, purchasing, or warehouse records. Coding is not required for completion. Advanced forecasting, AI-assisted analysis, and dashboard automation are covered at conceptual and operational application levels, while core calculations and policy design receive hands-on practice.
